content.text: Mariners TVIn-Market StreamingStream Mariners games with no local blackouts on Mariners.TV if you’re in Washington, Idaho, Oregon, Alaska, Montana or Hawaii—plus British Columbia or Alberta, Canada. Subject to national exclusivities. Seasonal and monthly plans are on sale now for $99.99/season or $19.99/month. Subscribe today at Mariners.TV.Need assistance? MLB Customer Support is available online and via phone. Fans who are already subscribed to providers carrying Mariners TV will automatically see the channel populate into their channel lineup. Mariners TV will televise all regular season Mariners games this season, apart from nationally exclusive broadcasts.Enter your ZIP code into the Channel Finder below to see the providers and channel numbers in your area. Sign up for MLB.TV today.Seattle Sports 710 AMSeattle Sports 710 AM is the radio home of the Mariners in the Pacific Northwest. Catch all Mariners games on the flagship station and its affiliates in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Alaska, and British Columbia. Fans in the Mariners broadcast territory can also go to the Seattle Sports 710 AM App or SeattleSports.com and listen to the game without any blackouts or restrictions. For more information on the affiliate stations, check out our broadcast affiliates page.Frequently Asked QuestionsSTREAMING FAQWill I be able to stream Mariners games?Yes! Mariners.TV on MLB.TV is the new Mariners direct-to-consumer streaming platform, allowing in-market access to live Mariners games. No cable or satellite subscription needed; no contract required.Are there blackouts?In-market Mariners.TV subscribers can stream all local Mariners broadcasts with no blackouts. Please note national exclusivities apply. Mariners.TV subscribers who are outside the Mariners home territory can still watch Mariners games while they are traveling and are only subject to the opposing team’s local blackout restrictions, if applicable.How will it work and how much does it cost?Mariners.TV will work on a variety of devices through the MLB App and can be purchased at a discounted rate of $99.99 per year or $19.99 per month. Seasonal and monthly plans are on sale now.Will I be able to watch Mariners games if I have a standard MLB.TV package, but not the Mariners.TV package?Mariners fans living within the Mariners home television territory must purchase a Mariners.TV subscription to stream Mariners games. Only fans who live outside the Mariners home market will be able to watch Mariners games with the standard MLB.TV package.Who should I contact if I need customer support?MLB Customer Support is available online and via phone. Contact Now >>CABLE, SATELLITE & INTERNET TV FAQCan I still watch Mariners games through my cable, satellite or internet TV provider?Yes! Mariners TV is available across major providers including Xfinity, DIRECTV, FUBO, Spectrum and more for fans throughout Washington, Idaho, Oregon, Montana and Alaska.What channel will Mariners TV be on?Enter your ZIP code into the Channel Finder on Mariners.com/Watch to see the providers and channel numbers in your area.Does Mariners TV replace ROOT SPORTS?Yes. Locally distributed Mariners games are now produced and distributed by Major League Baseball under the name Mariners TV beginning with the 2026 season.Can I authenticate access to Mariners games through the MLB App by using the credentials from my pay-TV provider?Yes, authenticated pay-TV providers will be able to authenticate to Mariners.TV through MLB.TV in the coming weeks.
